tldr: North Node in House 3: growth through voice, writing, learning, siblings, daily movement, and concrete truth.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop voice, writing, learning, siblings, daily movement, and concrete truth. The South Node in House 9 shows the familiar life field: belief systems, distant authority, inherited philosophy, or abstract certainty. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to name what is true in the immediate room.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses voice, writing, learning, siblings, daily movement, and concrete truth in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 9 can pull the person back toward belief systems, distant authority, inherited philosophy, or abstract certainty.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
